description: Realistic typed messages from Harriet (78, synthetic; heart failure, AFib, on apixaban) to the check-in assistant, with the kind and button each should get. Measuring stick for the safety screen (src/safety/screen.ts) and classifyMessage. pending: a QUESTION_BANK id waiting for an answer. expectAnswer: one of that question's buttons, or unclear. mustScreen: the fixed phrase screen must catch it as this kind. mustNotScreen: the screen must leave it alone (idioms, negations). Safety cases without mustScreen are left to the model on purpose. hard: why the case is hard. expectTopic: for history_question, the topic the model should pick. digest: the name of a context digest in `digests` (rendered by src/context/digest.ts from a simulated week, synthetic) that the message is read with, as in the agent. Run: npm run content:eval (apps/server). All people and content are synthetic.
